name: violeta-mobile
description: Contenedor movil de Violeta para iOS y Android usando Capacitor.

scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync && npm run patch:android-generated
scripts.cap:open:android: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && npm run patch:android-generated && npx cap open android
scripts.run:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.run:android: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && npm run patch:android-generated && npx cap run android
scripts.build:android:release: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && npm run patch:android-generated && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:ios:simulator: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -target App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO BUILD_DIR="$PWD/ios/App/build/Unified/Build/Products" OBJROOT="$PWD/ios/App/build/Unified/Build/Intermediates.noindex" SYMROOT="$PWD/ios/App/build/Unified/Build/Products" build
